name: @w6w-apps/discord
description: Send messages, manage channels, members, and roles on Discord servers.

w6w.longDescription:
Discord lets a workflow post and manage content on a server the same way a bot would — sending messages, reacting to them, and reading, creating, updating and deleting channels as a process needs to communicate with a community or team.

Roles and membership are manageable directly: roles can be created, updated and deleted, and added to or removed from a specific member, which covers a workflow granting or revoking access as someone completes an onboarding step or a subscription changes. Guild, channel and message data can all be listed or fetched individually, so a workflow can react to what's already there rather than only creating new content.

A good fit for turning an external event into a Discord notification, running moderation or role-management logic from outside Discord itself, or building a lightweight community-ops workflow around a server.
